race.comment: BIG OPINION (6) gets the nod in a competitive CL3. His last two runs have more merit than the form figures suggest, with wide runs at Gundagai and Corowa and now a significant drop from 61.5kg to 56kg. Yet to tick the box at this trip but Boudvillain reuniting signals intent. Bold showing anticipated. BIFURCATION (9) is in excellent order, winning over 1200m at Corowa after an eye-catching run at Albury in the slop. Gets in light for her first look at 1400m. Main danger. KOKONDA (2) is chasing three straight and arrives third-up and is still improving. Obvious threat. SUPER PARADISE (1) returns and while he's yet to win fresh, he's 2/2 second-up. Has been fitted with a jumpout win that suggested he could be ready to fire fresh. Heywood's booking is another good lean. DEEKAYGEEBEE (8) has to rebound from a plain Canberra run but his form prior was right up to scratch. No reason he won't get things back on track.
